verdict.rationale: Pylon documents its own Support Agent, which can be assigned to customer issues, answer from content, take action, and have its outcomes inspected in an issue log. The homepage also claims agents help with 'resolving' customer work. However, the docs frame the agent's customer-facing role as 'deflect[ing]' questions, and nothing shows end-to-end autonomous resolution or a resolution metric distinct from deflection. Missing for 10: documented autonomous end-to-end resolution, a resolution-rate metric separate from deflection or bounces, evidence of what share of conversations is resolved, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work —investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
You can also assign an individual issue to your AI agent, the same way you might normally assign an issue to a team member.
